exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and ask and answer questions, as in the example (continued). 2 (woman taking photos) Tracey / painter / live on a farm / paint - take pictures. 3 (couple on bicycles) We / teachers / live in a house / teach - ride bicycles.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang va namunadagidek savol-javob qiling (davomi). 2 (ayol suratga olyapti) Tracey / painter / live on a farm / paint - take pictures. 3 (er-xotin velosipedda) We / teachers / live in a house / teach - ride bicycles.
exercises.explanationUz:
NAMUNA (8-bet):
  A: What does Tom do? B: He's a
  doctor. A: Where does he live?
  B: He lives in a flat. A: Is he
  treating patients right now? B:
  No, he's making a pizza.

  2 Tracey - she; painter; farm;
    painting? - taking pictures
  3 We - you/we; teachers; house;
    teaching? - riding bicycles

  ⚠ 3-suratda savol 'you' bilan,
  javob 'we' bilan: What do YOU
  do? WE're teachers.
exercises.exampleEn: A: What does Tom do? B: He's a doctor. A: Where does he live? B: He lives in a flat. A: Is he treating patients right now? B: No, he's making a pizza.
exercises.exampleUz: A: Tomning kasbi nima? B: U shifokor. A: U qayerda yashaydi? B: Kvartirada. A: U hozir bemorlarni davolayaptimi? B: Yo'q, u pitsa tayyorlayapti.
modelAnswers: 2 A: What does Tracey do? B: She's a painter. A: Where does she live? B: She lives on a farm. A: Is she painting right now? B: No, she's taking pictures.
3 A: What do you do? B: We're teachers. A: Where do you live? B: We live in a house. A: Are you teaching right now? B: No, we're riding bicycles.
modelAnswersUz: 2 Treysining kasbi nima? - U rassom. Qayerda yashaydi? - Fermada. Hozir rasm chizyaptimi? - Yo'q, suratga olyapti.
3 Kasbingiz nima? - Biz o'qituvchimiz. Qayerda yashaysiz? - Uyda. Hozir dars beryapsizmi? - Yo'q, velosipedda yuryapmiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the present simple or present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
SINDINING YAMAYKADAN XATI.

  CONTINUOUS (hozir / shu kunlarda /
  aniq reja):
  1 'm writing (hozir yozyapman)
  2 are staying (shu kunlarda)
  3 'm sitting (Right now)
  4 'm drinking
  5 is walking
  6 's collecting
  8 are spending (shu kunlarda)
  9 are going (Tonight - reja)
  10 are leaving (on Tuesday -
     reja)

  SIMPLE (holat, doimiy, his):
  7 is (ob-havo holati)
  11 make (umuman)
  12 are (xarakter)
  13 love (his-tuyg'u fe'li -
     continuous bo'lmaydi!)
  14 don't want (his-tuyg'u)


⚠ 'GORGEOUS':

  = go'zal, ajoyib.


⚠ 'TO LEAVE FOR':

  = ... ga jo'namoq.

items.textEn: I ___ (write) from the gorgeous island of Jamaica!
Jim and I ___ (stay) in a five-star hotel by the sea.
Right now, I ___ (sit) on the balcony
and I ___ (drink) a delicious fruit punch.
Jim ___ (walk) along the beach.
He ___ (collect) shells and rocks to bring back home.
The weather ___ (be) hot and sunny.
We ___ (spend) most of the day relaxing and reading under the beautiful palm trees.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Shu kunlarda → Continuous ('spend' ham qabul qilinadi - odat sifatida).

items.textEn: Tonight, we ___ (go) to a reggae festival
and on Tuesday we ___ (leave) for Barbados.
The Jamaican people ___ (make) you feel happy
as they ___ (be) cheerful and kind.
I ___ (love) it here so much
that I ___ (not/want) to leave!

exercises.instructionEn: Tick the correct sentence, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'G'RI GAPNI TOPISh - 1-UNIT
  BARChA QOIDALARI.

  1 a - 'Most people ... live'
    (doimiy fakt → Simple)
  2 a - 'We're having a great
    time' (hozir; 'have' bu
    ma'noda Continuous bo'ladi)
  3 b - 'What are you doing NOW?'
    (hozir → Continuous)
  4 a - 'He's flying ... tomorrow'
    (reja → Continuous)
  5 b - 'We are seeing some friends
    this evening' (reja)
  6 b - 'Farmers work in the
    fields' (umumiy fakt)
  7 a - 'Give the gift to HIM'
    (predlogdan keyin tushum)
  8 b - 'What ARE the Chinese
    like?' (millat ko'plik)
  9 b - 'Brian HASN'T got'
    (3-shaxs)
  10 b - 'A vet can TREAT' (can
     dan keyin -s yo'q)

items.textEn: a) Most people in Thailand live in villages. b) Most people in Thailand are living in villages.
a) We're having a great time. b) We have a great time.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Hozir → Continuous ('have a great time' - harakat).

items.textEn: a) What do you do now? b) What are you doing now?
a) He's flying to Oslo tomorrow. b) He flies to Oslo tomorrow.
a) We see some friends this evening. b) We are seeing some friends this evening.
a) Farmers are working in the fields. b) Farmers work in the fields.
a) Give the gift to him. b) Give the gift to he.
a) What is the Chinese like? b) What are the Chinese like?
a) Brian haven't got blue eyes. b) Brian hasn't got blue eyes.
a) A vet can treats sick animals. b) A vet can treat sick animals.

exercises.explanationUz:
1-UNIT UMUMIY TEST.

  1 Peter HATES (3-shaxs -s)
  2 She DOESN'T like
  3 How many students ARE there
  4 Tara'S GOT (Tara has got)
  5 CAN I have (so'rov)
  6 What DOES Laura do? (kasb)
  7 I'm SEEING (reja)
  8 Sarah and I AREN'T (we)
  9 a picture of ME (predlogdan
    keyin)
  10 Look at THEM
  11 Where IS Sue from?
  12 DOES Ann like


⚠ 'TARA'S GOT':

  'S = has (got bilan).

She ___ like cold weather.
How many students ___ there in your class?
Tara's ___ a friendly smile.
___ I have some water, please?
"What ___ Laura do?" "She's a dancer."
I'm ___ my friend this evening.

This is a picture of ___ and my father.

patterns.formula: Right now, I'm + V-ing (hozir) / Tonight we're + V-ing (reja)
patterns.exampleEn: Right now, I'm sitting on the balcony. Tonight, we're going to a reggae festival.
patterns.exampleUz: Hozir men balkonda o'tiribman. Bugun kechqurun reggi festivaliga boramiz.

patterns.formula: I love / want / hate + ... (his-tuyg'u fe'llari - faqat Simple)
patterns.exampleEn: I love it here so much that I don't want to leave!
patterns.exampleUz: Bu yer menga shunchalik yoqadiki, ketishni xohlamayman!
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ love, want, hate, like - Continuous bo'lmaydi.

patterns.formula: Most people + FE'L (ko'plik, -s yo'q) — umumiy fakt
patterns.exampleEn: Most people in Thailand live in villages. Farmers work in the fields.
patterns.exampleUz: Tailandda ko'pchilik qishloqlarda yashaydi. Fermerlar dalada ishlaydi.
